notes: Residential population: INSEE Filosofi 2021, 200m national grid (real census data, already fine-grained, no placement needed). Jobs: INSEE SIRENE establishment-level registry (real address per establishment, headcount reported as a size bracket rather than an exact count), snapped to the nearest real OpenStreetMap building footprint -- replaces the older population-weighted job estimate used on earlier France maps. Commuting flows: INSEE RP2022 individual mobility microdata, aggregated to a full commune-to-commune matrix, minimum 10km origin-destination distance enforced. Routes calculated via OSRM on the real road network. — Reviewer refinements (2026-11-17): scored against paris-ile-de-france (pierreggt, reviewed medium 0.59, 2026-08-23), which the author declares runs this same pipeline (Filosofi 200m residents; SIRENE establishments snapped to building footprints for within-commune job placement; full commune-to-commune census commute matrix; 10km O-D floor). workplace_count re-ruled physical_measured, not size_bands — each commune's job total is the place-of-work side of the RP2022 commute matrix, a measured count; SIRENE's employee-count brackets only decide where those jobs land inside the commune (paris ruling: the commute census fixes the total and SIRENE only decides the spatial distribution within it). workplace_granularity re-ruled adm3, not adm5 — the measured totals are per commune; an establishment address is a placement point, not a reporting unit. workplace_resolution re-ruled osm_footprints, not mesh_125_or_adm5 — establishments are snapped onto OpenStreetMap building footprints, so the final placement geometry is OSM (muenchen precedent; paris scored ml_hybrid_footprints because it snaps to Overture). workplace_intensity re-priced fine_types_calibrated, not measured_per_unit — employee-count bracket weights, held to the measured commune totals by construction (paris ruling). resident_resolution re-ruled mesh_250, not mesh_125_or_adm5 — Filosofi is a 200m grid (paris / reunion). Resident count, granularity and intensity CONFIRMED as filed. od_metric full_matrix at adm3 CONFIRMED — the 10km minimum O-D distance re-draws short commutes, so those pairs are not reproduced, but the measured matrix remains the source (paris carries the same floor and kept full_matrix). Alternatives on record: ml_hybrid_footprints (if the snap layer is Overture, as on paris) 0.592, same medium tier; size_bands count (if SIRENE bracket sums, not the RP2022 commune totals, set each commune's jobs) 0.490, medium. Upgrade path as for paris: snapping to IGN BD TOPO official footprints would lift R to exact_footprints and the map to high (0.637). FR floor (medium) met. Revised high 0.65 -> medium 0.58.
